      "source": [
        "model = YOLO('yolov8n.pt')  # small & fast, good for Colab CPU/GPU\n",
        "VEHICLE_CLASSES = {2: 'car', 3: 'motorcycle', 5: 'bus', 7: 'truck'}\n",
        "print(model.names)"
      ],

            "{0: 'person', 1: 'bicycle', 2: 'car', 3: 'motorcycle', 4: 'airplane', 5: 'bus', 6: 'train', 7: 'truck', 8: 'boat', 9: 'traffic light', 10: 'fire hydrant', 11: 'stop sign', 12: 'parking meter', 13: 'bench', 14: 'bird', 15: 'cat', 16: 'dog', 17: 'horse', 18: 'sheep', 19: 'cow', 20: 'elephant', 21: 'bear', 22: 'zebra', 23: 'giraffe', 24: 'backpack', 25: 'umbrella', 26: 'handbag', 27: 'tie', 28: 'suitcase', 29: 'frisbee', 30: 'skis', 31: 'snowboard', 32: 'sports ball', 33: 'kite', 34: 'baseball bat', 35: 'baseball glove', 36: 'skateboard', 37: 'surfboard', 38: 'tennis racket', 39: 'bottle', 40: 'wine glass', 41: 'cup', 42: 'fork', 43: 'knife', 44: 'spoon', 45: 'bowl', 46: 'banana', 47: 'apple', 48: 'sandwich', 49: 'orange', 50: 'broccoli', 51: 'carrot', 52: 'hot dog', 53: 'pizza', 54: 'donut', 55: 'cake', 56: 'chair', 57: 'couch', 58: 'potted plant', 59: 'bed', 60: 'dining table', 61: 'toilet', 62: 'tv', 63: 'laptop', 64: 'mouse', 65: 'remote', 66: 'keyboard', 67: 'cell phone', 68: 'microwave', 69: 'oven', 70: 'toaster', 71: 'sink', 72: 'refrigerator', 73: 'book', 74: 'clock', 75: 'vase', 76: 'scissors', 77: 'teddy bear', 78: 'hair drier', 79: 'toothbrush'}\n"

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "LOW_THRESH = 5\n",
        "HIGH_THRESH = 12\n",
        "\n",
        "def detect_vehicles(frame, conf=0.25):\n",
        "    results = model.predict(frame, conf=conf, verbose=False)[0]\n",
        "    boxes = []\n",
        "    for box in results.boxes:\n",
        "        cls_id = int(box.cls[0])\n",
        "        if cls_id in VEHICLE_CLASSES:\n",
        "            x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, box.xyxy[0])\n",
        "            boxes.append((x1, y1, x2, y2, VEHICLE_CLASSES[cls_id], float(box.conf[0])))\n",
        "    return boxes\n",
        "\n",
        "def density_level(count):\n",
        "    if count <= LOW_THRESH:\n",
        "        return \"LOW\"\n",
        "    elif count <= HIGH_THRESH:\n",
        "        return \"MEDIUM\"\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return \"HIGH\"\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "2DB0iZ8g23PU"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "MIN_GREEN = 15   # seconds\n",
        "MAX_GREEN = 60   # seconds\n",
        "\n",
        "def green_time_for(count, min_count=0, max_count=20):\n",
        "    count = max(min_count, min(count, max_count))\n",
        "    ratio = (count - min_count) / (max_count - min_count + 1e-6)\n",
        "    return int(MIN_GREEN + ratio * (MAX_GREEN - MIN_GREEN))\n",
        "\n",
        "# quick test\n",
        "for c in [2, 6, 10, 15, 20]:\n",
        "    print(f\"vehicles={c:2d} -> density={density_level(c):6s} -> green_time={green_time_for(c)}s\")\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },

            "vehicles=15 -> density=HIGH   -> green_time=48s\n",

              "/**\n",

              "(function(scope) {\n",
              "function span(text, styleAttributes = {}) {\n",
              "  const element = document.createElement('span');\n",
              "  element.textContent = text;\n",
              "  for (const key of Object.keys(styleAttributes)) {\n",
              "    element.style[key] = styleAttributes[key];\n",

              "  return element;\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// Max number of bytes which will be uploaded at a time.\n",
              "const MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 100 * 1024;\n",
              "\n",
              "function _uploadFiles(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const steps = uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId);\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  // Cache steps on the outputElement to make it available for the next call\n",
              "  // to uploadFilesContinue from Python.\n",
              "  outputElement.steps = steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  return _uploadFilesContinue(outputId);\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// This is roughly an async generator (not supported in the browser yet),\n",
              "// where there are multiple asynchronous steps and the Python side is going\n",
              "// to poll for completion of each step.\n",
              "// This uses a Promise to block the python side on completion of each step,\n",
              "// then passes the result of the previous step as the input to the next step.\n",
              "function _uploadFilesContinue(outputId) {\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  const steps = outputElement.steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const next = steps.next(outputElement.lastPromiseValue);\n",
              "  return Promise.resolve(next.value.promise).then((value) => {\n",
              "    // Cache the last promise value to make it available to the next\n",
              "    // step of the generator.\n",
              "    outputElement.lastPromiseValue = value;\n",
              "    return next.value.response;\n",
              "  });\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * Generator function which is called between each async step of the upload\n",
              " * process.\n",
              " * @param {string} inputId Element ID of the input file picker element.\n",
              " * @param {string} outputId Element ID of the output display.\n",
              " * @return {!Iterable<!Object>} Iterable of next steps.\n",
              " */\n",
              "function* uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const inputElement = document.getElementById(inputId);\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = false;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  outputElement.innerHTML = '';\n",
              "\n",
              "  const pickedPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    inputElement.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n",
              "      resolve(e.target.files);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  const cancel = document.createElement('button');\n",
              "  inputElement.parentElement.appendChild(cancel);\n",
              "  cancel.textContent = 'Cancel upload';\n",
              "  const cancelPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    cancel.onclick = () => {\n",
              "      resolve(null);\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Wait for the user to pick the files.\n",
              "  const files = yield {\n",
              "    promise: Promise.race([pickedPromise, cancelPromise]),\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'starting',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "\n",
              "  cancel.remove();\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Disable the input element since further picks are not allowed.\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = true;\n",
              "\n",
              "  if (!files) {\n",
              "    return {\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'complete',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  for (const file of files) {\n",
              "    const li = document.createElement('li');\n",
              "    li.append(span(file.name, {fontWeight: 'bold'}));\n",
              "    li.append(span(\n",
              "        `(${file.type || 'n/a'}) - ${file.size} bytes, ` +\n",
              "        `last modified: ${\n",
              "            file.lastModifiedDate ? file.lastModifiedDate.toLocaleDateString() :\n",
              "                                    'n/a'} - `));\n",
              "    const percent = span('0% done');\n",
              "    li.appendChild(percent);\n",
              "\n",
              "    outputElement.appendChild(li);\n",
              "\n",
              "    const fileDataPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "      const reader = new FileReader();\n",
              "      reader.onload = (e) => {\n",
              "        resolve(e.target.result);\n",
              "      };\n",
              "      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "    // Wait for the data to be ready.\n",
              "    let fileData = yield {\n",
              "      promise: fileDataPromise,\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'continue',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "\n",
              "    // Use a chunked sending to avoid message size limits. See b/62115660.\n",
              "    let position = 0;\n",
              "    do {\n",
              "      const length = Math.min(fileData.byteLength - position, MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE);\n",
              "      const chunk = new Uint8Array(fileData, position, length);\n",
              "      position += length;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const base64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk));\n",
              "      yield {\n",
              "        response: {\n",
              "          action: 'append',\n",
              "          file: file.name,\n",
              "          data: base64,\n",
              "        },\n",
              "      };\n",
              "\n",
              "      let percentDone = fileData.byteLength === 0 ?\n",
              "          100 :\n",
              "          Math.round((position / fileData.byteLength) * 100);\n",
              "      percent.textContent = `${percentDone}% done`;\n",
              "\n",
              "    } while (position < fileData.byteLength);\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  // All done.\n",
              "  yield {\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'complete',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "}\n",

              "};\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import tensorflow as tf\n",
        "from tensorflow.keras import layers, models\n",
        "from tensorflow.keras.applications.mobilenet_v2 import MobileNetV2, preprocess_input\n",
        "from tensorflow.keras.preprocessing.image import ImageDataGenerator\n",
        "import pandas as pd, os\n",
        "\n",
        "IMG_SIZE = (224, 224)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Auto-locate train.csv and its matching images folder.\n",
        "# This dataset keeps labeled training images in a folder called \"train\" (sibling of train.csv),\n",
        "# not \"images\" — confirmed from the extracted folder listing.\n",
        "CSV_PATH = None\n",
        "for root, dirs, filenames in os.walk(\"data\"):\n",
        "    if \"train.csv\" in filenames:\n",
        "        CSV_PATH = os.path.join(root, \"train.csv\")\n",
        "        IMAGES_DIR = os.path.join(root, \"train\")\n",
        "        break\n",
        "\n",
        "assert CSV_PATH is not None, \"Could not find train.csv under data/ — check the folder listing from the kaggle download cell and set CSV_PATH / IMAGES_DIR manually.\"\n",
        "assert os.path.isdir(IMAGES_DIR), f\"Found {CSV_PATH} but no matching image folder at {IMAGES_DIR} — check the folder listing and set IMAGES_DIR manually.\"\n",
        "print(\"Using CSV_PATH:\", CSV_PATH)\n",
        "print(\"Using IMAGES_DIR:\", IMAGES_DIR)\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(CSV_PATH)\n",
        "df['emergency_or_not'] = df['emergency_or_not'].astype(str)  # flow_from_dataframe wants string labels for class_mode='binary'\n",
        "print(df.head())\n",
        "print(df['emergency_or_not'].value_counts())\n",
        "\n",
        "datagen = ImageDataGenerator(preprocessing_function=preprocess_input, validation_split=0.2)\n",
        "\n",
        "train_gen = datagen.flow_from_dataframe(\n",
        "    df, directory=IMAGES_DIR, x_col='image_names', y_col='emergency_or_not',\n",
        "    target_size=IMG_SIZE, batch_size=32, class_mode='binary', subset='training'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "val_gen = datagen.flow_from_dataframe(\n",
        "    df, directory=IMAGES_DIR, x_col='image_names', y_col='emergency_or_not',\n",
        "    target_size=IMG_SIZE, batch_size=32, class_mode='binary', subset='validation'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "base_model = MobileNetV2(input_shape=IMG_SIZE + (3,), include_top=False, weights='imagenet')\n",
        "base_model.trainable = False\n",
        "\n",
        "ev_model = models.Sequential([\n",
        "    base_model,\n",
        "    layers.GlobalAveragePooling2D(),\n",
        "    layers.Dense(64, activation='relu'),\n",
        "    layers.Dropout(0.3),\n",
        "    layers.Dense(1, activation='sigmoid')\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "ev_model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='binary_crossentropy', metrics=['accuracy'])\n",
        "history = ev_model.fit(train_gen, validation_data=val_gen, epochs=8)\n",
        "\n",
        "ev_model.save('emergency_classifier.h5')\n",
        "print(\"Class indices:\", train_gen.class_indices)  # confirms which label (0/1) maps to which class\n"
      ],

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "def is_emergency_vehicle(frame, box, threshold=0.5):\n",
        "    x1, y1, x2, y2, _, _ = box\n",
        "    crop = frame[max(0,y1):y2, max(0,x1):x2]\n",
        "    if crop.size == 0:\n",
        "        return False, 0.0\n",
        "    crop = cv2.resize(crop, IMG_SIZE)\n",
        "    crop = preprocess_input(crop.astype('float32'))\n",
        "    crop = np.expand_dims(crop, axis=0)\n",
        "    prob = ev_model.predict(crop, verbose=0)[0][0]\n",
        "    # NOTE: check train_gen.class_indices to confirm which label is index 1\n",
        "    return prob >= threshold, float(prob)\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "QUPtQ7Hx7aaz"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Training images were reasonably close-up, clear shots. Vehicle boxes from an elevated/\n",
        "# distant traffic camera can be as small as ~15-40px, which is too little real detail to\n",
        "# classify reliably after upscaling to 224x224 -- the model ends up reacting to interpolation\n",
        "# noise rather than genuine visual cues, producing falsely confident wrong answers.\n",
        "# So: only classify crops above a minimum size; treat anything smaller as \"too far to tell\"\n",
        "# (non-emergency by default) rather than force an unreliable guess.\n",
        "MIN_CROP_SIZE = 50  # pixels, both width and height\n",
        "\n",
        "def classify_boxes_batch(frame, boxes, threshold=0.5):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Classify all vehicle crops from one frame in a single batched prediction\n",
        "    (much faster than calling ev_model.predict() once per box).\"\"\"\n",
        "    if not boxes:\n",
        "        return []\n",
        "\n",
        "    results = [None] * len(boxes)\n",
        "    crops = []\n",
        "    crop_indices = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for i, (x1, y1, x2, y2, _, _) in enumerate(boxes):\n",
        "        crop = frame[max(0,y1):y2, max(0,x1):x2]\n",
        "        h, w = crop.shape[:2] if crop.size else (0, 0)\n",
        "        if crop.size == 0 or w < MIN_CROP_SIZE or h < MIN_CROP_SIZE:\n",
        "            results[i] = (False, 0.0)  # too small/far to classify reliably\n",
        "            continue\n",
        "        crop = cv2.cvtColor(crop, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)  # training used RGB (via ImageDataGenerator/PIL); cv2 frames are BGR\n",
        "        crop = cv2.resize(crop, IMG_SIZE)\n",
        "        crops.append(preprocess_input(crop.astype('float32')))\n",
        "        crop_indices.append(i)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if crops:\n",
        "        batch = np.stack(crops, axis=0)\n",
        "        probs = ev_model(batch, training=False).numpy().flatten()  # direct call, avoids .predict() per-call overhead\n",
        "        for idx, p in zip(crop_indices, probs):\n",
        "            results[idx] = (p >= threshold, float(p))\n",
        "\n",
        "    return results\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def process_video(input_path, output_path=\"output_annotated.mp4\", frame_skip=3):\n",
        "    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(input_path)\n",
        "    fps = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS) or 25\n",
        "    w = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH))\n",
        "    h = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT))\n",
        "    out = cv2.VideoWriter(output_path, cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*'mp4v'), fps, (w, h))\n",
        "\n",
        "    frame_idx = 0\n",
        "    log = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    while True:\n",
        "        ret, frame = cap.read()\n",
        "        if not ret:\n",
        "            break\n",
        "        frame_idx += 1\n",
        "        if frame_idx % frame_skip != 0:\n",
        "            continue\n",
        "\n",
        "        boxes = detect_vehicles(frame)\n",
        "        count = len(boxes)\n",
        "        dlevel = density_level(count)\n",
        "        gtime = green_time_for(count)\n",
        "\n",
        "        classifications = classify_boxes_batch(frame, boxes)\n",
        "        emergency_present = False\n",
        "\n",
        "        for b, (emergency, prob) in zip(boxes, classifications):\n",
        "            x1, y1, x2, y2, label, conf = b\n",
        "            color = (0, 0, 255) if emergency else (0, 255, 0)\n",
        "            if emergency:\n",
        "                emergency_present = True\n",
        "            cv2.rectangle(frame, (x1, y1), (x2, y2), color, 2)\n",
        "            cv2.putText(frame, f\"{label} {conf:.2f}\", (x1, y1-5),\n",
        "                        cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.5, color, 2)\n",
        "\n",
        "        signal_state = \"GREEN (EMERGENCY OVERRIDE)\" if emergency_present else f\"GREEN {gtime}s (density {dlevel})\"\n",
        "        signal_color = (0, 0, 255) if emergency_present else (0, 200, 0)\n",
        "\n",
        "        cv2.putText(frame, f\"Vehicles: {count}\", (10, 30),\n",
        "                    cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.8, (255,255,255), 2)\n",
        "        cv2.putText(frame, f\"Signal: {signal_state}\", (10, 60),\n",
        "                    cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.8, signal_color, 2)\n",
        "\n",
        "        out.write(frame)\n",
        "        log.append({\"frame\": frame_idx, \"count\": count, \"density\": dlevel,\n",
        "                     \"green_time\": gtime, \"emergency\": emergency_present})\n",
        "\n",
        "    cap.release()\n",
        "    out.release()\n",
        "    return pd.DataFrame(log)\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "vthrPOJ9JVEm"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "results = {}\n",
        "\n",
        "for label, path, out_name, log_name in [\n",
        "    (\"traffic\", VIDEO_PATH, \"output_traffic.mp4\", \"traffic_log.csv\"),      # frame_skip default (3) applies\n",
        "    (\"emergency\", EMERGENCY_VIDEO_PATH, \"output_emergency.mp4\", \"emergency_log.csv\"),  # short clip, default is fine too\n",
        "]:\n",
        "    print(f\"Processing {label} video: {path}\")\n",
        "    log_df = process_video(path, output_path=out_name)\n",

              "      if (!google.colab.kernel.accessAllowed) {\n",
              "        return;\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const div = document.createElement('div');\n",
              "      const label = document.createElement('label');\n",

              "      div.appendChild(label);\n",
              "      const progress = document.createElement('progress');\n",
              "      progress.max = size;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(progress);\n",
              "      document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
              "\n",
              "      const buffers = [];\n",
              "      let downloaded = 0;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const channel = await google.colab.kernel.comms.open(id);\n",
              "      // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "      channel.send({})\n",
              "\n",
              "      for await (const message of channel.messages) {\n",
              "        // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "        channel.send({})\n",
              "        if (message.buffers) {\n",
              "          for (const buffer of message.buffers) {\n",
              "            buffers.push(buffer);\n",
              "            downloaded += buffer.byteLength;\n",
              "            progress.value = downloaded;\n",
              "          }\n",
              "        }\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const blob = new Blob(buffers, {type: 'application/binary'});\n",
              "      const a = document.createElement('a');\n",
              "      a.href = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n",
              "      a.download = filename;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(a);\n",
              "      a.click();\n",
              "      div.remove();\n",
              "    }\n",

            "application/javascript": [
              "\n",
              "    async function download(id, filename, size) {\n",
              "      if (!google.colab.kernel.accessAllowed) {\n",
              "        return;\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const div = document.createElement('div');\n",
              "      const label = document.createElement('label');\n",
              "      label.textContent = `Downloading \"${filename}\": `;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(label);\n",
              "      const progress = document.createElement('progress');\n",
              "      progress.max = size;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(progress);\n",
              "      document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
              "\n",
              "      const buffers = [];\n",
              "      let downloaded = 0;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const channel = await google.colab.kernel.comms.open(id);\n",
              "      // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "      channel.send({})\n",
              "\n",
              "      for await (const message of channel.messages) {\n",
              "        // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "        channel.send({})\n",
              "        if (message.buffers) {\n",
              "          for (const buffer of message.buffers) {\n",
              "            buffers.push(buffer);\n",
              "            downloaded += buffer.byteLength;\n",
              "            progress.value = downloaded;\n",
              "          }\n",
              "        }\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const blob = new Blob(buffers, {type: 'application/binary'});\n",
              "      const a = document.createElement('a');\n",
              "      a.href = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n",
              "      a.download = filename;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(a);\n",
              "      a.click();\n",
              "      div.remove();\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  "
            ]

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "roads = [\"North\", \"East\", \"South\", \"West\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "def simulate_cycle():\n",
        "    counts = {r: random.randint(0, 20) for r in roads}\n",
        "    emergency_road = random.choice(roads + [None, None, None])  # ~25% chance an emergency vehicle appears\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"=== Traffic snapshot ===\")\n",
        "    for r in roads:\n",
        "        c = counts[r]\n",
        "        print(f\"{r:6s}: {c:2d} vehicles -> density {density_level(c):6s} -> green {green_time_for(c)}s\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print()\n",
        "    if emergency_road:\n",
        "        print(f\"🚨 Emergency vehicle detected on {emergency_road} road -> signal forced GREEN immediately, others RED.\")\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        highest = max(counts, key=counts.get)\n",
        "        print(f\"No emergency vehicle. Longest green time given to {highest} road ({counts[highest]} vehicles).\")\n",
        "\n",
        "simulate_cycle()\n"
      ],
